name: Half-Kneeling Adductor Rock-Back
steps: Start on hands and knees and extend one leg out to the side with that foot flat.
Keep your back steady and sit your hips toward the kneeling heel until the inner thigh of your straight leg stretches.
Hold the stretch there and breathe evenly before shifting your weight forward.
Bring the extended knee underneath you and switch sides.
tips: Keep your lower back flat rather than rounding your spine as you sit your hips back.
Keep the entire outer edge of your extended foot pressed lightly into the floor.
